old: Custom vial boxes need more control than a generic carton because a small glass vial can move, tilt or contact the box wall during handling. The structure should be planned around the vial diameter, height, cap or closure, insert depth, opening direction and information panel before artwork is finalized. That approach helps procurement teams compare a folding carton, sleeve-and-tray box or rigid kit on the factors that affect fit and production.

Custom vial boxes are secondary paper packaging for filled and sealed vials, supplied with a carton, sleeve-and-tray or rigid outer format and a fitted insert. VPN develops the package from the actual vial diameter, total height, cap profile, count and filled weight. Nominal 2 mL, 5 mL or 10 mL volume is a starting reference rather than a dimensional specification; the approved sample determines the fit. We manufacture the boxes, not glass vials or sterile primary containers. Minimum order: 1,000 units. Sample fees and timing, production lead time and freight depend on the confirmed design, quantity and destination.

VPN Paper Box manufactures custom printed cartons with fitted inserts for filled and sealed glass vials in Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam. We make single-vial cartons and multi-vial packs for bulk orders from brands and packaging distributors.
body_edits.new: A fitted insert needs to hold a filled glass vial steady, leave clearance for its cap and let staff lift it out without pulling on the closure. Check those fit points with a representative vial before approving the carton.

old: VPN Paper Box Manufacturer develops custom vial packaging boxes for brands, laboratories, supplement companies, healthcare suppliers, cosmetic sample programs and distributors. The product page is focused on standalone vial boxes, single-vial cartons, multi-vial cartons and protective inserts. The final structure, material and print specification should be confirmed with the real vial and an approved sample.

We size each insert from the finished vial, including its height, body diameter, closure and label. These measurements help determine how the vial sits in the box and how easily it can be removed. Review the carton, insert and printed artwork together on a physical sample before bulk production.
body_edits.new: VPN manufactures printed outer cartons and fitted inserts in Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam. For bulk orders, we develop single-vial or multi-vial layouts around the filled and sealed vials you intend to pack.

old: Our team has supplied custom vial boxes and related paper packaging for customers in international markets including India, the United States, the United Kingdom, Pakistan and Australia. These projects have given us experience working with different box structures, artwork requirements, shipping destinations and export-packing instructions.

We have experience exporting custom paper packaging in bulk from Vietnam to the United States, Canada, Australia and European markets. For a vial box order, send your quantity by design, delivery destination and required receiving date so we can confirm the packing and freight details in your quote.
body_edits.new: Before a bulk order leaves Vietnam, agree whether the cartons and fitted inserts should arrive assembled or packed separately. When several vial sizes share one carton design, label each insert layout by SKU so the receiving team can match it to the correct vial.

old: Minimum order quantity and lead time depend on the confirmed box structure, board or rigid material, insert type, finishing, artwork status and order quantity. Shipping and export packing requirements should also be discussed for the destination market and the finished pack-out.

Minimum order: 1,000 units. Sample fees and timing, production lead time and freight depend on the confirmed box structure, board or rigid material, insert, finishing, artwork status, order quantity and destination. Confirm these details separately in the written quotation before production begins.
body_edits.new: We confirm the minimum order quantity and production lead time in your quote. The minimum depends on the box structure, board, fitted insert and artwork. If your order includes several designs, list the quantity for each one.

old: Short answer: choose the insert only after the finished vial has been measured. A nominal 2 mL, 5 mL or 10 mL volume does not define the body diameter, total height, shoulder, cap, label projection or filled weight. Those physical inputs—not the volume label alone—determine the cavity and outer box.
body_edits.new: For the fit sample: send the widest body diameter, total height, cap dimensions and filled weight. Include the label if it extends beyond the glass. Two 10 mL vials can have different shoulders and caps.
